text: AI is changing the workplace by automating routine tasks like data entry and scheduling, which allows employees to focus on more creative and strategic work. Productivity tools such as virtual assistants and smart software help workers organise their time and analyse information faster. However, rather than replacing humans, AI often works alongside them in human-AI collaboration, where people guide machines and check their outputs. This shift means some jobs will evolve, requiring new skills like interpreting AI data or managing automated systems. Workers who adapt by learning these skills can benefit from more efficient and rewarding careers in the modern workplace.
